items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Joe Page or Joe Daley was the publisher

ctx.x: No, Bill Williams. He used to write lyrics and Joe Page or Joe Daley was the publisher and Claude Hopkins wrote the music, and I said to Claude, 'you should give me $100 for that tune?' I said, 'that made you. You took that as your theme song.' 'I would swim the ocean wide, I would cross that great divide. I'd do almost anything for you.' I says 'how we come to write that, Carey said we got to have a jump number and I was playing (humming) and I started just putting it backwards. Oomphaing it, and I said, I got…
That's what you did, you took that and played it backwards. So 'Nagasaki' backwards, I would do most anything for you.
